sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body: Thank you for your offer. We have reviewed the referenced records and weigh them in our decision. Our revised proposal follows; the referenced data and our volumes support this level. Our own orders for this exact part were placed at 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) and 5.84 EUR (po:4500014427-10); our proposal reflects that record. We commit to a binding volume for the full term: 23,700 units per year over 24 months, firm. Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
To support your firm volume commitment, we are prepared to accept the 24-month contract term, the AS-14404 index clause, and 45 days payment terms.
In exchange for these terms, we propose a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for continuing to work with us. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

We appreciate your flexibility regarding payment terms to help reach an agreement. In exchange for reducing the payment terms to 30 days net, we can lower our price to €5.30 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. You again mentioned market data, but we have not received any figures; please share this data for our review. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
